description: This source file is a Next.js page component for booking events. It displays a form to the user where they can input their details to book a specific event, identified by a URL parameter. The page dynamically displays event information based on a predefined list of event names and handles form submission with a simulated redirect.

methods.name: BookPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders a booking form for an event identified by URL parameters, manages loading state, and handles submission with a simulated redirect.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, prevents default behavior, sets loading state, and redirects to the bookings page after a delay.
